BiblicalUsage: The one occurrence of this word names the town of Shikkeron on the border of Judah, where the boundary goes out to the sea. The lexicon's first sense is drunkenness, but the verse itself is a place on a map.
TheologicalSignificance: The town is what the verse means, whatever the root once meant. I believe place names are God's geography, and Shikkeron is on His map even if I never visit it.
